jobs.description_text: Nursing Care Coordinator (LPN / RN) Location: Hollywood, FL (In-Office) Schedule: Full-Time Salary: $30.00 an hour- $35.00 an hour About Infinite Medical P.C. Position Overview Infinite Medical P.C. is seeking an on-site, detail-oriented Licensed Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to serve as a Nursing Care Coordinator. Operating strategically in an administrative role, you will review and verify chart documentation to ensure compliance and support seamless continuity of care for our patient population. Key Responsibilities Compliance & Records Review : Evaluate patient records and Review Visit Logs (RVLs) to ensure clinical accuracy and strict adherence to CMS and internal operational guidelines. Professional Development : Participate in mandatory operational and educational meetings, complete post-training surveys, and cross-train in expanding care management verticals. Systems Utilization : Maintain proficiency across primary digital platforms, including Emsow, PointClickCare, Sigma/Matrix, Reliable/Visual, Yardi-One and Google Workspace. About MedElite Since 2011, MedElite has been dedicated to improving the standard of care in skilled nursing and long-term care facilities nationwide. We implement a data-driven, "treat in place" model that enhances resident health outcomes while saving valuable time and resources for our partner organizations. By managing a network of advanced practice providers and specialty clinicians, we deliver high-quality, proactive care directly to the bedside. Our passion for positively impacting the lives of residents, administrators, and healthcare professionals drives our commitment to continuously innovate and redefine senior care across the country. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clinical providers while supporting the early detection and management of vision conditions in a geriatric population. jobs.title: Patient Monitoring Coordinator (RN)
jobs.description_text: Patient Monitoring Coordinator (RN) Location: Hollywood , FL Schedule: Full-Time Salary: $28.85 an hour - $36.06 an hour (based on CPT codes) About Infinite Medical P.C. Job Summary We are seeking a dedicated RN CoCM Care Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing patient charts and communicating with the Clinical department and providers about any irregularities as part of chronic care management. Responsibilities Provide assessment and care management services, including: Administration of validated rating scales. Initiation of behavioral health care planning concerning behavioral or psychiatric health problems. Revision and modification of care plans for patients not progressing or whose status changes. Brief psychosocial interventions as needed. Engage in ongoing collaboration with the billing practitioner. Maintain the registry/tracking sheets. Consult with the psychiatric consultant. Maintain a continuous relationship with patients. Foster collaborative, integrated relationships with the rest of the care team. Conduct interdisciplinary care plan meetings to review patient beneficiaries. Requirements RN License required Experience in long-term care is preferred. Experience in behavioral health preferred. Benefits Competitive salary: $28.85 an hour - $36.06 an hour (based on CPT codes) Health Dental Vision 401K Company-Sponsored Life Insurance Paid Time Off Why Work With Us?

jobs.title: Podiatrist
jobs.description_text: Podiatrist Location: Queens, NY Schedule: Part-Time (2 days/ week) Total Annual Compensation: $60,000 - $90,000 per year About Infinite Medical P.C. Job Summary We are seeking a friendly and compassionate Podiatrist to join our team. As a Podiatrist, you will play a crucial role in providing comprehensive care to patients in long-term care facilities. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference in the lives of patients while working alongside a dedicated team of healthcare professionals. Responsibilities Performed examinations on patients’ legs and feet to identify and diagnose various diseases and conditions. Provide treatment for foot and leg injuries, such as fractures, corns, and calluses. Recommend and prescribe medication for relieving joint pain and suggest foot orthoses to enhance mobility and alleviate discomfort. Offer guidance and advice to patients regarding foot care and overall wellness practices. Request additional medical tests as necessary based on the initial assessments. Requirements Doctor of Podiatric Medicine (DPM) degree DEA License Long-term care experience Prolonged standing/walking. Occasional lifting up to 20 lbs. Bending/stooping. Benefits Competitive salary: $60,000 - $90,000 per year Paid subscription to UpToDate Malpractice Insurance Why Work With Us? Make a meaningful impact on the lives of seniors Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment Enjoy work-life balance with the flexibility of a part-time schedule Equal Opportunity

jobs.location_raw: Costa Mesa, California, United States · Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Discovery is Anduril's team for the hard concepts: the ones that are not yet proven or built. We take the newest and hardest problems across space, missiles, air, sensors, autonomy, and cyber, decide what is worth building, and prove it out: we build the models, break the assumptions, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. We work with hardware and software engineering teams across the company, driving cross-functional collaboration across different business lines. ABOUT THE JOB We are building an expeditionary force: a small group of engineers who want to do big, new, hard things and who move into unfamiliar territory as a matter of course. As a Discovery Engineer you pick up a concept nobody has proven, learn whatever domain it lives in, build the analysis or prototype that tests it, and get to an answer. The problems change; the approach does not: reason from first principles, do the work, check it, and reach a solution. You are not hired for a particular skill set. You are hired for a record of getting engaged in problems across different areas, being analytic, testing new concepts, and getting to solutions. You are also the adversary to our own ideas. The rigor that validates a good concept is the same rigor that kills a bad one early, while it is still cheap, and you apply it to your own work first.
